motivation: The offline repair planner previously accepted a bare sourceReceiptsMatched=12 flag without checking per-market-date frozen source digests in the actual census artifact.
changeSummary: Full 11843-key read-only census now retains twelve market/date official SHA256+count source revalidation receipts and an aggregate deterministic SHA256 digest
Offline missing-only planner requires exact all-12 immutable source receipts and aggregate digest before preparing any candidate batch
Repair plan digest binds the exact census source digest, preserving PIT provenance and resisting mismatched-revision carryover
Tampered digest, wrong individual source hash and missing source receipt adversarial tests fail closed
auditHandoff: AUDIT_LANE uses hashes to independently compare D1 census report to the frozen official source receipt. DATA_LANE cannot self-close CORR-003.
